answer: In Proof of Agent epoch 10, Sybil resistance hinges on a proof-of-resource-stake: each agent must lock a verifiable slice of real-world compute—measured in standardized ferrous-core cycles—into a contract before participating. The cost of forging this stake is not merely financial but physical: attackers must provision genuine, tamper-resistant hardware whose operational burn rate makes hollow replication economically ruinous, especially when the chain periodically audits uptime via cryptographic beacons tied to ivory-indexed attestations from trusted execution environments.
